subject.title: build(deps): bump the actions group across 1 directory with 3 updates

question: Should a workflow-area owner approve these three reviewed GitHub Action revision updates for merge?
rationale: The patch is mechanically correct and green, but accepting changed third-party CI action code is an owner supply-chain judgment rather than a code repair decision.

options.title: Approve the reviewed pins
options.body: Confirm the three immutable SHAs resolve to the intended upstream releases and merge this clean dependency update.

options.title: Hold for additional upstream review
options.body: Pause the update if the action-release changes need broader supply-chain review before this repository executes them.

recommendation.title: Approve the reviewed pins
